exact 81-file bootstrap candidate and A6 review-baseline-before SHA256 inventory
Remediation 6 on-disk artifacts and independent governance-test reruns

review_scope.boundary: This review assesses the bootstrap Rule governance mechanism. It does not approve any railway business Rule.

methods_and_commands.command: PowerShell Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 and byte-size comparison for each review-baseline-before candidate, frozen_history, remediation_6, migration_320_task and migration_320_external entry
methods_and_commands.observed: 81/81 candidate, 256/256 frozen history, 38/38 R6, 13/13 M320 Task and 5/5 external evidence entries matched; governance-commit-manifest SHA256 matched.

methods_and_commands.command: Read-only inspection of rule.schema.json, domain/index.yaml, all six meta registries, proposed-domain-rules.mjs, rule-class.mjs and validate-task.mjs Rule loader/selector paths
methods_and_commands.observed: The production loader reads only fixed meta and Domain registries; source reports are not dereferenced as Rules. All 11 meta Rules are typed procedural or technical controls and no meta Rule has a domain or compatibility category.

68/68 passed; Rule cases 57-63 covered proposed-only registry, confirmed Domain rejection, candidate/applicable separation, generic meta business rejection, unsupported railway authority, allowed governance/technical controls and duplicate identity rejection.
20/20 passed; PROD-11 rejected a Domain candidate in applicable_rules, PROD-12 rejected generic meta business authority, and PROD-13 rejected duplicate/first-match authority.

10/10 mutations killed; MUT-09-GENERIC-META-BUSINESS and MUT-10-RULE-FIRST-MATCH were killed. An earlier reviewer command used a relative TEMP, causing only duplicated temp-root module resolution; it was discarded and the absolute-path rerun exited 0.
Two isolated 68-case reports were valid, run/case roots were unique, caller IDs were ignored, and four forged report families were rejected.

methods_and_commands.command: Temporary in-memory Node probe under reviewer-temp/domain importing the exact production schema and Rule modules; probe file removed after execution
methods_and_commands.observed: Missing rule_class produced schema and class errors; agent-filled authority fields and confirmed Domain status were rejected; railway_domain_authority and generic meta business category were rejected; a Domain candidate resolved only in candidate_rules; governance and technical controls resolved only with their matching effects. Two initial node -e quoting attempts failed before imports and were replaced by the scoped temporary probe.
VALIDATE_TASK_RESULT structural=VALID calculated_gate=NO-GO exit=2; candidate Rule human-decision reason and all original blockers remained. No --write-graph flag was used.

independent_formal_review.reason: Reviewer identities are unique, do not match the R6 implementer session, and no implementation conversation was used.

explicit_rule_class_required.reason: rule_class and authority_effect are required by schema and missing/unsupported class is rejected again by the production classifier.

governance_control_procedural_only.reason: The only accepted effect is procedural_governance; the exact candidate contains nine such meta controls.

technical_constraint_technical_only.reason: The only accepted effect is technical_constraint; the exact candidate contains two such meta controls.

railway_domain_candidate_candidate_only.reason: All six Domain entries are proposed railway_domain_candidate/candidate_only records; selection accepts them only through candidate_rules.

railway_domain_authority_unsupported.reason: railway_domain_authority maps only to unsupported and is always rejected in bootstrap mode.

generic_meta_business_authority_rejected.reason: Business categories cannot use governance/technical classes and meta registries cannot carry railway classes; the production and mutation paths independently detect the A5 exploit family.

missing_class_rejected.reason: Independent exact-module probe produced one schema error and three fail-closed class/registry violations.

inferred_authority_rejected.reason: Owner, approved_at, human_owner, approval or authority fields on a proposed Domain entry are rejected and cannot create authority.

status_based_promotion_rejected.reason: Domain status is limited to proposed/candidate/unverified; confirmed is rejected and does not trigger any approval lookup.

confirmed_domain_schema_resolver_positiv.reason: Phase 1 loads no dedicated Domain approval schema or approval resolver and exposes no proposed-to-confirmed function. Optional future-shaped fields in the generic Rule schema are inert for Domain entries because the registry validator rejects them. The fixture suite contains confirmed Domain rejection, not a positive authority fixture.

indirect_business_claims_unloaded.reason: The Rule loader reads only .codex/meta-rules/*.yaml and .codex/domain/index.yaml; report, implementation, migration and test source references are not dereferenced or promoted. Exact-candidate meta statements were inspected and contain no domain or compatibility category.

absence_of_confirmed_authority.reason: The approved bootstrap contract intentionally contains no confirmed railway authority. Its absence is a safety boundary, not a defect or additional blocker.

no_actual_railway_rule_approved.reason: This review closes a mechanism defect only and grants no business authority.

findings.title: Migration 320 candidate Rules remain proposed and require human Domain decision
findings.reproducible_read_only_check: Run node .codex/scripts/validate-task.mjs --task-id GOV-M320-DRYRUN without --write-graph; observe Candidate Domain Rules require human decision and VALID/NO-GO/exit 2.
findings.observed: WO-P-C-LINK-001, WO-C-SHORTAGE-001 and COMPAT-M320-001 are candidate_rules only; no confirmed authority exists and Migration 320 remains NO-GO.
findings.decision_required: Confirm, reject, or retain each proposed Migration 320 Rule as unverified before any business approval or execution.
findings.disposition: Preserve NEEDS_HUMAN_DECISION and NO-GO. This is the approved fail-closed state and is not a mechanism defect.

a5_closure.original_failure_condition: A category=domain confirmed Rule in the generic meta registry could previously become applicable without Domain human authority.
reproducible_read_only_checks: Production integration PROD-12 rejects the exact generic confirmed meta business-category exploit.
Mutation MUT-09 removes the business-category guard and is killed by PROD-12.
Independent in-memory exact-module probe rejects category=domain plus governance_control/procedural_governance in registry=meta.
a5_closure.reason: Classification is now namespace-independent for business categories, meta registries are restricted to procedural/technical classes, Domain records are proposed-only candidates, and selection resolves unique typed records. The A5 exploit no longer reaches business applicable_rules.

limitations: Bootstrap evidence is produced by mutable workspace code and establishes INTERNAL_CONSISTENCY_ONLY, not trusted producer, Git, commit or release authority.
No Git state, service, product code, product test, database, seed, migration source or migration execution was inspected or run.

The deterministic loader and classifier operate on explicit typed Rule records. Indirect report, implementation, migration and test claims remain unloaded source metadata; any future candidate manifest or typed Rule change requires a new review.
No actual railway maintenance, permission, inventory, audit or compatibility Rule was approved.

One relative-TEMP mutation command and two node -e quoting probes were reviewer command errors; all were retried within the approved absolute reviewer temp boundary, and only the successful corrected results were used.

conclusion.bootstrap_rule_mechanism: PASS: A5-DOMAIN-META-REGISTRY-BYPASS-001 is CLOSED for the exact Phase 1.6 bootstrap candidate.
conclusion.railway_business_authority: NOT_GRANTED: the confirmed authority count remains zero by approved design, and that absence is not a blocker.
conclusion.migration_320: NEEDS_HUMAN_DECISION / NO-GO: three proposed candidate Rules and all three original blockers remain.
